annotations.title: Look up a public participant record

description: Returns the public fields of an active, public participant record in the Weio registry by id, including public_key (base64url Ed25519) when the record was registered with a key, so you can check that a message was signed with the key registered on that record; or not found (private, missing and withdrawn records look the same).
name: registry_verify
title: Look up a public participant record
